title: Ubiquitous-language evidence
description: Evidence produced by the ubiquitous-language leg: a manifest of the domain glossary produced by the domain-modeling skill (`/domain-modeling` → CONTEXT.md). The file itself travels on the engine's `outputs:` transport (issue #68), not in an Actions artifact.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions run id of the leg run — provenance only; the combine hook reads the files from the engine-staged tree, not from an artifact.

files.description: Manifest of the files the leg published to its `outputs:` tree (paths relative to the tree root); the engine collects that tree and stages it for the combine hook as inputs/<leg>/.
